# Navimower Map Card 0.3.7-beta27

## Backend-owned Resume

- Consume Navimower 0.4.5-beta37's per-mower `task_resume` contract instead of treating Charging/Docked as implicitly resumable.
- Prefer the live **Task progress** attributes `resume_available`, `resume_strategy`, `resume_reason` and `resume_evidence`, with Map API `frontend.task_resume` as the backend metadata fallback.
- Call `navimower.continue_task` when the new contract is available, allowing the integration to choose ordered-run continuation or vendor Resume.
- Keep a Paused-only legacy fallback for older integrations which expose only `navimower.resume`.
- Apply the same per-member logic in Multi mower mode.

## Mow and Resume controls

- Remove the old light-blue outline from Mow.
- Keep **Mow** blue as the primary action.
- Show **Resume** in the same blue primary style when it is available, so Mow and Resume form one balanced two-button row.
- When Resume is unavailable, Mow spans the full two-column control width.
- Apply the same visual/layout rules to Multi mower member controls.

## LiDAR editor capability

- Stop inferring LiDAR editor visibility from mower model names.
- Use the integration-provided `frontend.terrain_overlay.supported` capability for Single and Multi mower cards.
- Continue to keep the LiDAR section visible when an existing card already selects `LiDAR terrain` or `LiDAR elevation`, so the setting can always be changed back to `None`.
- LiDAR rendering remains the existing authenticated integration-provided terrain/elevation overlay path.

## Backend pairing

Navimower **0.4.5-beta37 or newer** is recommended so Resume visibility and `continue_task` are fully backend-owned.
